pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless the initial trade has moved at least +$10 in open profit and volatility contraction is confirmed.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandate an ATR-based buffer for initial stop-loss placement to prevent wick hunting while keeping risk strictly capped between $4 and $6.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trail stops once profit hits +$15 and scale out partially before reaching +$30.
